messages.subject: Error bars with confidence limits with ggplot
parts:
Hi,

I wanted to create error bars with confidence limits for the following data. How can I do that. Data is found below:

structure(list(increase = c(15.6830902099609, -14.3426504135132, 
-0.734412729740143, 1.59326803684235, 1.04275894165039, 12.669810295105, 
1.91639697551727), l95 = c(-2.21568298339844, -24.1961402893066, 
-4.95035123825073, -0.646066725254059, -1.25538098812103, 1.27744698524475, 
-2.02227210998535), u95 = c(36.8581199645996, -3.20832705497742, 
3.66852307319641, 3.88306403160095, 3.39440107345581, 25.3436698913574, 
6.01339292526245), marker = c("crp", "ddimer", "eselectin", "fibrinogen", 
"icam", "il6", "vWF")), datalabel = "", time.stamp = "13 Aug 2013 12:25", .Names = c("increase", 
"l95", "u95", "marker"), formats = c("%8.0g", "%8.0g", "%8.0g", 
"%10s"), types = c(254L, 254L, 254L, 10L), val.labels = c("", 
"", "", ""), var.labels = c("", "", "", ""), row.names = c("1", 
"2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7"), version = 12L, class = "data.frame")

Thanks

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Error bars with confidence limits with ggplot
parts:
You've got everything lined up right in your dataframe. 

require(ggplot2)
?geom_errorbar()

df=structure(list(increase = c(15.6830902099609, -14.3426504135132,

-0.734412729740143, 1.59326803684235, 1.04275894165039, 12.669810295105, 
1.91639697551727), l95 = c(-2.21568298339844, -24.1961402893066, 
-4.95035123825073, -0.646066725254059, -1.25538098812103, 1.27744698524475, 
-2.02227210998535), u95 = c(36.8581199645996, -3.20832705497742, 
3.66852307319641, 3.88306403160095, 3.39440107345581, 25.3436698913574, 
6.01339292526245), marker = c("crp", "ddimer", "eselectin", "fibrinogen", 
"icam", "il6", "vWF")), datalabel = "", time.stamp = "13 Aug 2013 12:25", .Names = c("increase", 
"l95", "u95", "marker"), formats = c("%8.0g", "%8.0g", "%8.0g", 
"%10s"), types = c(254L, 254L, 254L, 10L), val.labels = c("", 
"", "", ""), var.labels = c("", "", "", ""), row.names = c("1", 
"2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7"), version = 12L, class = "data.frame")
ggplot(data=df, aes(x=marker, y=increase, ymin=l95, ymax=u95))+geom_point() +geom_errorbar()
